title: Bosch agrees to pay $36M as DOJ declines prosecution in export case.
snippet: June 18 (UPI) - German engineering and technology firm Bosch has agreed to pay a $36 million fine to resolve federal allegations that it exported restricted products and software to China's Huawei.

title: [Gasgoo express] Bosch China and Spirit AI reach strategic partnership; report: Geely to acquire Ford Spain plant production line.
snippet: * Gasgoo: On May 6, as embodied intelligence accelerates toward large-scale deployment, Spirit AI and Bosch China officially signed a strategic partnership agreement.

title: Spirit AI (千寻智能) and Bosch China (博世中国) sign strategic cooperation agreement to accelerate large-scale implementation of embodied intelligence.
snippet: On May 6, Spirit AI (千寻智能), a leading domestic embodied intelligence company, and Bosch China (博世中国), the global technology and services giant, officially signed a strategic cooperation agreement.
